# Educational TV Shows for Kids

*Last updated: June 10, 2026*

If you like your kids to learn a thing or two during their time in front of the TV, then be sure to check out our favorite educational TV shows. From [preschool programs](/lists/best-preschool-tv-shows) to improve reading readiness to shows for your avid [STEM](/lists/stem-apps-tv-and-more-for-science-tech-engineering-and-math) fan, this list is full of age-appropriate options that help [make TV time count](/articles/yes-you-can-make-tv-time-count). With classics like [*Sesame Street*](/tv-reviews/sesame-street) to newer favorites like [*Sid the Science Kid*](/tv-reviews/sid-the-science-kid)*,* there's no shortage of smart -- and fun -- shows out there for kids. And great shows like [*Breakthrough*](/tv-reviews/breakthrough) and [*First Life*](/tv-reviews/first-life-with-david-attenborough) provide plenty to watch for tweens and teens. So check out these picks, and learn a few things while you're at it.
